title: Good basics but inflexible interface
body: I purchased the app for a streamlined basic habit former and tracker. It has been reliable for the past year and linked well with ical. The notifications are excellent and I like the clean presentation. However, one area for improvement is the flexibility of the app. It would be useful to have a "reschedule" single swipe function to move a habit to another date when life gets in the way. For example, I was called into work to cover for a sick colleague and wanted to catch up on my reading goal of 10 pages a day, but could not load the habit onto a Saturday when I had time to read 30 pages - and did. Instead, I needed to reverse and tick the habit on the previous days which did not give a true picture of how the habit had played out in reality. I found that the weekly habits such as gym time (3 times a week) cannot easily be moved to another day if you miss a session. You can only tick completed, fail, or log progress or go into settings and change the daily schedule permanently. So on weeks where my work shifts changed, I would need to go back to Tuesday for a gym session completed on Thurs. Maybe there is an easy work around for all of this, but I could not see it. So a good all round app with reliable reminders but a bit inflexible at times.

Best habit app on the app store (at least for me).

title: Great app for tracking habit and mood with fair pricing
body:
I really like this app. Good for adults with ADHD. Great to track mood over time, as well as the ability to track and monitor mood several times per day if you subscribe to premium.

Offers one-off payment for lifetime subscription. Rare and appreciated for such a good app.

Powerful Shortcuts integration, and a cool API for the nerds among us (hi, I'm a nerd).

Would get 5 stars if it included an easy way to track  a negative habit. e.g. To quit smoking, I'd like to just tap once each time I have a cigarette, and have it automatically fail if I've had more than my 2 per day instead of having to manually create a log of 1 entry each time I mark the habit.

I'll pay for a lifetime subscription when that last issue is fixed. Worth it.
